capabilities.title: Build platforms from zero
capabilities.text: I've set up the delivery pipelines and cloud infrastructure new products need, moved monoliths to microservices, and taken prototypes to product lines with real users.

capabilities.title: Ship AI agents
capabilities.text: I've shipped agents and embeddings to production, backed by observability and by experiments against real datasets that help with prompt engineering.

capabilities.title: Modernise infrastructure
capabilities.text: I've led a platform's move to Kubernetes, helped migrate it from GCP to Azure, and recently worked with the .NET stack.

capabilities.title: Help set technical direction
capabilities.text: I've designed distributed systems that stay up and scale when they need to, and championed the best practices that keep them reliable.
